main_text.p: quantum possunt per Dei providentiam: hominum corpora & mentes obsident, ipsorumque bona lædunt, & oculos sæpe fascinant: hominespios tentant & castigant; denique homines impios seducunt & puniunt. Iob. 1. 1. Petr.5 v 8. Gen.3. v.4.5.15. 2.Cor.12.v.7. Apoc.12. Luc.8.v.27.30.32.5 Exod. 8. v. 7. Matth. 12. v. 25. 26. Ordo inter malos angelos est, quòd diabolus tanquam princeps præest reliquis. Matt. 25. v. 41. 2. Cor. 12. v. 7.
XV. Anima rationalis est spiritus, ordinatus ad vnionem & communionem corporis.10

XVI. Eius confideratio est generalis, & specialis. In genere consideretur anima rationalis quantum ad principium & propria adiuncta atque effecta. Princi-pium animæ est solus Deus, qui ex nihilo creat animam hominis, non autem illam producit ex traduce. Gen. 2. v. 7. Zach. 12. v. 1. Hebr. 12. v. 9.15 Propria eius adiuncta sunt, immortalitas in corpore mortali, & extra illud Matth. 10. v. 28. Apoc. 6. v. 10. 11. intellectus, qui potest aliquid cognoscere immediatè, sine ope phantasmatum, vel mediatè per phantasmata, in corpore vel extra corpus Luc. 16. Apoc. 6. v. 9. 10.20 voluntas, quæ fertur in obiectum suum, vel immediatè, absque appetitu sensitivo & affectibus corporeis, vel mediatè per appetitum sensitivum, in corpore, vel extra corpus. Matth. 22. v. 30. Marc. 12. v. 25. Luc. 20. v. 36. denique potentia agendi, quâ illa in corpore quidem movet cor-pus,25 & agit per corpus, separata autem à corpore agit immediatè. Gen. 2. v. 7. Luc. 16. Propria effecta animæ rationalis sunt proportionata adiunctis modo recitatis: videl. intelligere, meminisse, velle, movere, agere, in corpore vel extra corpus, hoc est, in statu vnionis vel separationis.30

In specie anima rationalis consideratur in statu felicitatis & miseriæ. Status felicitatis est, quo anima vnionem & communionem habet cum Deo, in quo vno acquiescit & triumphat. Et hæc dicitur monarchia animæ, quâ fit vt ipsa incipiat à Deo, inque ipso definat, tanquam primo intel-35

page.notes: The bottom catchword "ligi bi-" is partly unclear, so it is marked as read from the scan: [?] would apply to "ligi" if doubtful. The left margin has a small printer's or pointing mark at mid-page, not text, and is left out. Spacing between "homines" and "pios" is missing in print ("hominespios"), copied as printed. The "32" in the Luc. 8 reference line is hard to read and may be "32" or "3?" in print; a doubtful reading.
